test_cases.name: Verbose quote request with intervention-triggering unknown item
test_cases.description: A verbose and polite customer requests a quote for several catalog items and includes a non-catalog item, triggering intervention.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for Multiple Items – Including Specialty Product
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am reaching out on behalf of Mr. Fresh Foods to request a detailed quotation for several items we are considering for our upcoming inventory replenishment. We appreciate your prompt attention and the thoroughness of your quoting process.

Here is the list of products we would like to include in the quote:

- Kalamata Olive
- WonderWagon Bicycle
- Organic Carrot
- Playlandia Colorful Play Mat
- FreshHello Premium Olive Oil (please include this specialty item, which is a staple in our product lineup; we have not seen it in your catalog but would like pricing and availability details)

If you require any additional information or clarification regarding the above items, please let us know. We are particularly interested in competitive pricing and any available bulk purchase options. Kindly confirm receipt of this request and advise on the next steps for reviewing the quote record and the quote email before finalization.

Best regards,
Mr. Fresh Foods

test_cases.name: Verbose quote request with intervention-triggering unknown item

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for Toys, Apparel, and Special Item
initial_turn.body:
Hi there,

I'm looking to get a quote for a few things for our upcoming event. I want to make sure we have a mix of fun and practical items, so here's what I'm thinking:

- 2 MagicToyland Adventure Dolls (these are always a hit with the kids!)
- 5 T-Shirts (could you include a mix from your available styles? I saw several listed)
- 1 WonderWagon Bicycle (for our raffle prize)
- And, most importantly, I need a quote for a 'Danish Pastry Plush Toy'—do you carry this item? It's a plush toy shaped like a Danish pastry, which would be perfect for our theme. If you don't have it, maybe you can suggest something similar?

If you need any more details about quantities or event specifics, just let me know. I want to review everything before finalizing, so please send the quote for my review and let me check the email draft as well before you send it out.

Best regards,
Anders Nielsen
